Name: Screenshot Everywhere
Author: Gaiadin
Description:
Screenshot Everywhere does just that, takes a screenshot everywhere you go. But it's also customizable.

By default, the mod will screenshot the first time you enter a location that day. If you specify locations to screenshot, the mod will [b]only[/b] screenshot in those locations. There are a number of common locations you can choose from in the menu (using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]generic mod config menu[/url]) or the config.json file inside the mod folder. You can also add any location by name or unique name in the ScreenShotLocations config entry.

Screenshot Everywhere has a configurable hotkey to add or remove your current location to/from the list of locations you want to screenshot each day. Simply enter the location and press the hotkey (default "L"). If the location is already in your list of locations, it will be removed; otherwise it will be added. In either case, you will receive an in-game notification.

[b]﻿Note: [/b]locations in the ScreenShotLocations entry are separated by commas (,) with no spaces. Optionally, you can include a vertical bar(|) followed by a decimal value between 0 and 1 to set a custom zoom level for that location

[b]Example ScreenShotLocations entry:[/b] [b]"seedshop|.25,custom_JenkinsHouse,jojamart|1,backwoods,mountain|.75"[/b]

There is also a configurable screenshot button which allows you to take screenshots of any location at any time with the push of a button. These screenshots are saved in the same way that automatic screenshots are, so screenshotting a location which already has a screenshot for that day will overwrite the previous version.

Custom zoom levels by location allow you to take different resolution screenshots on different maps. This will make bigger maps take less time to capture by setting them to a lower zoom level. There is also a default zoom level which will be applied to any location which doesn't have a custom zoom level.

The ability to disable weather effects during screenshots means no more shady, dreary days in your screenshot diary!

Many thanks to the creators of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4779]Daily Screenshot[/url] mod whose source code provided a great deal of inspiration for this mod.

I wrot﻿e this mod for my buddy to use while we go through yet another run of Stardew. I decided to post it in case anyone else was looking for something similar to be able to chronicle their Stardew adventures!
